task_contract_support_for_verifier_defec.evidence: instruction.md requires independent scoped initialization and no reinitialization of parent singletons. The sole official failure demands that an as-yet-uninitialized parent singleton must not first initialize through a scope. The explicit no-reinitialization requirement alone does not establish that stronger first-initialization prohibition.

agent_test_relevance.evidence: model.patch:336-362 adds 'scoped containers can be initialized independently and do not reinitialize parent singletons': root.initialize runs first, then scope.initialize, and parentCount remains 1. Trajectory step 67 explicitly lists this test passing with 14 total passes; step 101 reconfirms the suite. It is related but uses an already-initialized parent context.

verifier_is_actual_behavior_failure.evidence: Archived test-stdout.txt:60-80 reports an executed initOrder discrepancy: ['parentSingleton','scoped'] versus ['scoped']. The suite has 1 failure and 23 passes. This is a runtime behavioral difference; its contractual wrongness remains unsettled.

reference_support.evidence: The shared official solution explicitly visits only local registrations, supporting the verifier's interpretation statically. No fresh S012 P/R raw execution was available. Static agreement of solution and tests does not resolve the original instruction ambiguity.

notes: The original test is a closer setup comparison than S011 because root initialization is a genuine prior action. However Step 1 must be resolved before a context edit can establish the requested phenomenon.
Needed evidence is an independent ownership rule excluding never-initialized parent singletons from scope initialization, or a separate unambiguous task defect.

task_contract_support_for_verifier_defec.evidence: instruction.md explicitly states 'Within each level, services initialize in parallel'; concurrency is an optional upper limit. tests/test.patch:426-465 registers three independent services and calls initialize() with no limit, expecting maxConcurrency > 1. model.patch:1112 passes options.concurrency ?? Infinity to runLevel, but lines 1031-1033 map non-finite concurrency to 1, serializing the default case.

agent_test_relevance.evidence: model.patch:191-210 adds 'limits concurrency within a level', registering three independent async initializers and calling initialize({concurrency:2}); it asserts maxActive <= 2 and maxActive == 2. Trajectory steps 56/57 author the test; steps 61, 65, 70, 79 and 91 explicitly report that selected test PASS. Step 100 reports all 181 tests passed.

verifier_is_actual_behavior_failure.evidence: Archived test-stdout.txt:60-75 reports the executed 'initializes independent services concurrently' test receiving maxConcurrency 1 when >1 is expected. The selected concurrency assertion is the only official failure; 23 other new tests pass.

reference_support.evidence: Late fresh baselines: verifier_delivered/repeat_01 and repeat_02 execute maxConcurrency > 1 and fail with 1; verifier_reference/repeat_01 and repeat_02 pass. The isolated original it block in agent_selected_{delivered,reference}/repeat_{01,02} passes. Its full body is byte-identical to the original and the original file has no shared hooks. Entire-file reference TypeScript errors remain preserved separately.

notes: The exact target initialize({concurrency:2}) and official initialize() differ in an explicit target argument. Removing concurrency or replacing 2 with Infinity is an input change, so it cannot be counted as setup-only recovery.
An unrelated ambient Number.isFinite monkeypatch would change the language/runtime semantics rather than establish a natural precondition of the same API call.
